description: This file contains implementations for logging to a file within the Orleans testing host framework. It defines a class for managing log output streams (`FileLoggingOutput`) and a class for logging messages (`FileLogger`) that utilizes `FileLoggingOutput`). The classes handle log message formatting, file handling, and disposable resource management.

classes.name: FileLoggingOutput
classes.description: Handles writing log messages to a file with buffering and periodic flushing, ensuring thread safety and proper disposal.

classes.name: FileLogger
classes.description: Implements the ILogger interface to log messages to a file via a FileLoggingOutput instance.

classes.name: NullScope
classes.description: A singleton disposable type used as a no-op scope for the logger.

methods.name: CurrentDomain_ProcessExit
methods.description: Event handler to dispose all FileLoggingOutput instances when the application exits.

methods.name: FileLoggingOutput
methods.description: Constructor to initialize log file and writer.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Formats and writes a log message with proper synchronization.

methods.name: FormatMessage
methods.description: Creates a structured log message string including timestamp, level, caller, message, and exception.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes log output stream safely, with error handling.

methods.name: BeginScope
methods.description: Provides a no-op scope for logging.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Indicates logging is enabled for all levels.

methods.name: FileLogger
methods.description: Constructs a logger for a specific category.
